zh: 题目保证每次 from 有数据、to 没有数据，所以只需要维护“哪些位置有数据”这个集合。
每次迁移就是在集合中删除 from、加入 to，不需要知道具体是哪一份数据。
用哈希集合存初始位置，依次处理 m 次迁移，最后把集合排序，先输出元素个数，再输出升序位置（n=0 时第二行为空）。
en: Every move is guaranteed to have data at from and none at to, so all you need is the set of occupied positions.
A move just deletes from and inserts to in that set; which piece of data moved does not matter.
Put the initial positions in a hash set, apply the m moves in order, then sort the set and print its size followed by the positions in ascending order (the second line is empty when n=0).

explanationEn:
## Approach

A set stores the positions that hold data; for each move, remove from and add to; sort at the end.

## Proof of correctness

Initially the set equals the set of occupied positions. A valid move removes exactly one old position and adds one empty position, leaving the others unchanged, so every step keeps the two equal; the final sort only changes the output order.

## Complexity

Expected O(m+n log n) time and O(n+m) space including the input.
